n: 30" Built In Microwave Oven With Convection Cooking
c: Black Stainless Steel with PrintShield™ Finish
desc: This convection microwave oven can quickly and thoroughly defrost, melt or cook your favorite foods. The EasyConvect™ Conversion System takes the guesswork out of convection cooking, ensuring exceptional results.
hl: Circulates heat around the oven cavity with a 1200-watt convection element that allows baking at temperatures up to 450° F.
Combines the high power and even coverage needed to achieve results similar to outdoor grilling results.
Sensor Steam Cycle with Steamer Container
A sensored microwave oven cycle that allows precise steaming based on the food type and doneness level selected.
Provides large cooking capacity while complementing your convection oven.
Allows the microwave oven to be used for grilling, frying and convection cooking in the microwave.
Takes the guesswork out of convection cooking by ensuring exceptional results when experimenting with new recipes or familiar favorites.
